body.statement: For every \(G\in\mathfrak D(V)\), every \(H\in\mathfrak F_G\) satisfies \(\mathcal I_E(H)=\mathcal I_E(G)\), the finite family \(\mathfrak F_G\) is closed under componentwise directed-and-bidirected edge union, and \(\Gamma(G)\in\mathfrak F_G\) is its unique greatest member with \(\mathcal I_E(\Gamma(G))=\mathcal I_E(G)\). These conclusions retain all internal bidirected edges and bidirected loops exactly while completing only occupied cross-SCC bidirected rectangles.
body.justification: It isolates the maximal regime where direct substitution works.
body.gap: Published local moves are not packaged as simultaneous mixed saturation.
body.consumer: It supplies base cases and reduction tests for transfer.
